prompt:
Create a contemporary, polished desktop homepage UI mockup for FoodBridge at 1536×1024, edge-to-edge real website screenshot with crisp legible interface text, no device or browser frame. FoodBridge coordinates food sharing and separate waste collection in Sri Lanka. Preserve its name. All five roles must be equally discoverable: Donor, Recipient, Recycler, Volunteer, Admin. Recipients and recyclers can register for review; browsing and claims are not available yet. Admins sign in, never publicly register. Never invent metrics, live activity, endorsements, testimonials, maps, certifications, or deployed capabilities.

Visual direction: contemporary digital product with a photographic editorial sensibility. Bright white space, near-black evergreen typography, fresh pale green support and a controlled vivid lime accent. Precise modern sans-serif typography with a confident display scale and quieter regular-weight body copy. Generous margins, refined alignment, subtle borders, compact controls, and softly rounded photographic crops. Avoid the dated institutional look: NO road signs, numbered destinations, giant pictograms, thick green stripes, directory tables, glossy gradients, ornamental blobs, drop-shadow stacks, or repetitive role cards.
Composition C is an immersive contemporary editorial canvas, built around a close overhead photograph of an everyday community table with fresh produce, reusable containers and the hands of Sri Lankan adults sharing food. No face is necessary; photography has exquisite natural light and rich true-to-life colours. FoodBridge's compact white navigation sits in a calm light strip: wordmark, "How it works", "Community impact", "Sign in". A single large image spans almost the entire opening, with generous rounded corners and restrained margins; avoid a standard copy-left/photo-right split.

Instead of copy floating everywhere, make one very intentional off-centre light panel embedded across the lower portion of this photographic canvas. Its headline reads "A little surplus. A lot of possibility." with the explanation "Food sharing and waste collection in Sri Lanka." Keep this panel contemporary, flat, spacious and typographically precise. Integrated into its base is a single five-option role gateway with visible labels "Donor", "Recipient", "Recycler", "Volunteer", "Admin" and clear directional link affordances, all equal in prominence. No selected default role. State "Admin access requires sign-in." and the readable disclosure "Recipient and recycler browsing and claims are not available yet." The next section begins visibly below the photograph with "Make every handover count" and a quiet "View community impact" action. This is a complete functional homepage opening, not merely a photograph with a slogan.
